title: A cooldown you can test
description:
Write `Cooldown`, an ability cooldown that reads time through an injected clock, so tests can control time.

- The constructor takes a clock (`std::function<double()>`, returning seconds) and a duration in seconds.
- `ready()`: true if the ability may be used now: it has never been used, or at least `duration` seconds have passed since the last use.
- `use()`: if ready, records the current time as the last use and returns `true`; otherwise returns `false` and changes nothing.
- `remaining()`: seconds until ready (0 if ready now).

Then write the test-side helper `FakeClock`: `now()` returns the current fake time (starting at 0), `advance(seconds)` moves it forward.
hints: Remember the time of the last use (an `std::optional<double>`, empty before the first use). Remaining time is the last use plus the duration minus now, never below 0.
`ready()` is simply "remaining is 0". `use()` records the clock's time only when ready.
